# The Barral Institute

> > The Barral Institute is a health education organization specializing in visceral and neural manipulation techniques founded by Jean-Pierre Barral, offering certification programs and continuing education for manual therapy practitioners.

The Barral Institute provides comprehensive training in manual therapy techniques including Visceral Manipulation, Neural Manipulation, and advanced approaches developed by founder Jean-Pierre Barral. The organization serves physical therapists, osteopaths, and other healthcare practitioners seeking evidence-based continuing education and professional certification.

## Key Topics

- Visceral Manipulation
- Neural Manipulation
- Jean-Pierre Barral
- Manual Therapy
- Certification Programs
- Osteopathy
- New Manual Articular Approach
- Manual Approach to the Brain
- Barral Method
- Continuing Education
- Physical Therapy
- Practitioner Training
- Pain Management
- Evidence-Based Healthcare

## Core Courses & Certifications

- [Available Barral Institute Courses](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses): Catalog of Visceral, Neural, and advanced manual therapy courses
- [Certification Programs](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses/certification-programs): Barral Institute certification programs for manual therapy practitioners
- [Visceral Manipulation](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses/vm): Visceral Manipulation course overview and therapeutic benefits
- [Neural Manipulation](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses/nm): Neural Manipulation course by Barral and Croibier for nerve mobility
- [New Manual Articular Approach](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses/nmaa): New Manual Articular Approach (NMAA) joint treatment course
- [Manual Approach to the Brain](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses/mab): Manual Approach to the Brain for neurological conditions
- [Evidence-Based and Evidence-Informed Healthcare](https://www.barralinstitute.com/courses/healthcare): Evidence-based manual therapy training and clinical education
